description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the GenerateCartoonizedImage operation in the image production (imageenhan) category
description_zh: 本文介绍图像生产（imageenhan）类目下的生成式图像卡通化GenerateCartoonizedImage的语法及示例
name: GenerateCartoonizedImage

parameters.help_en: The URL of the input image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS URL is in a region other than Shanghai, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 输入图像的URL链接。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en:
The cartoon effect. Valid values:
0: retro comic (default)
1: 3D fairy tale
2: anime
3: fresh and clean
4: futuristic tech
5: traditional Chinese painting
6: battle general
7: colorful cartoon
8: elegant Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
卡通效果。取值如下：
0：复古漫画（默认）
1：3D童话
2：二次元
3：小清新
4：未来科技
5：国画古风
6:  将军百战
7:  炫彩卡通
8：清雅国风
parameters.name: index
